text:
elaine: Quick design review request — I pushed a new Figma for the usage/cost panel. Thinking about switching from stacked cards to a compact matrix view for org vs workspace comparisons. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/cost-insights

max: :eyes: opened. matrix view could save vertical space. do we lose discoverability for invoices though?

elaine: Good call. Current idea: top row = time selector + org/workspace toggle, second row = 3 tiles (total cost, active tokens, avg latency), below = matrix with projects as rows and cost categories as columns. invoices would be an actions column with a download icon.

joel: I worry about the actions column being too hidden on narrow screens. maybe make invoice download always available from the top-right flyout?

maya: Also accessibility note — some of the color ramps in figma fail WCAG AA at smaller swatches. we should add a high-contrast palette variant.

elaine: Agree, @maya can you propose alt colors? I'll add a toggle in the design system for "high contrast" that the dashboard can flip.

maya: Will do. small CSS snippet I'm suggesting for the legend focus styles:
```css
.legend-item:focus {
  outline: 3px solid #005FCC; /* meets 3:1 */
  border-radius: 4px;
}
```

max: Nice. On the matrix: should we show absolute $ + percent-of-org in the same cell, or split into two columns?

joel: I prefer single cell with stacked micro-typography: $ on top, % below. avoids horizontal scrolling. can add tooltip with sparkline for trend.

elaine: Stacked micro-typography it is. UX question: org vs workspace context — when a user toggles to org, do we gray out workspace-level actions (like downloading project invoices) or show cross-project actions? thoughts?

max: Show both but emphasize the primary context. maybe dim project-level CTAs by 30% and surface an "expand" chevron to open per-project details. less surprise for users.

maya: Also callout: table keyboard navigation. If matrix is keyboard focusable, arrow keys should move between cells and Enter opens invoice modal. need aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Project X — compute: $123 (20%)\"`.

elaine: Good. I'll update the spec with aria sample. quick sketch for the invoice flow: top-right kebab -> "Export invoices" -> modal with date range + format (CSV/PDF). put an inline note: "exports respect your org/project filter".

joel: For mobile, switch matrix to vertical list where each project expands into an accordion with the same columns stacked. keeps parity with desktop but easier to tap.

max: One more thing: cost attribution labels — "tokens" vs "inference tokens" vs "embedding tokens" caused confusion in last usability test. recommend explicit labels and a short tooltip. e.g., "Generation tokens (prompt + completion)".

elaine: Good catch. I'll replace ambiguous terms and add microcopy.

console-bot: Deploy preview available at https://console.redwood.ai/preview/cost-insights/17698 — snapshot expires in 48h :robot_face:

maya: Will audit contrast and keyboard flows today.

joel: I'll prototype the matrix accessibility interactions and attach a Loom.

elaine: Thanks all — aim to ship iteration to staging for the next design review on Tue. :thumbsup:
